nodes.summary: The Bonferroni local test of the intersection hypothesis `H_J` at level `α`: reject when some `j ∈ J` has `p j ≤ α / |J|`. (It never rejects `H_∅`.)
nodes.title: Bonferroni local test of an intersection hypothesis

nodes.summary: The closed testing procedure: given the decisions `φ J` of local tests of the intersection hypotheses `H_J`, reject `Hᵢ` exactly when `φ J` holds for every `J` containing `i`.
nodes.title: Closed testing procedure

nodes.summary: For `α ≥ 0`, the hypotheses rejected by Holm's step-down procedure are exactly those rejected by the closed testing procedure built on the Bonferroni local tests.
nodes.title: Holm's procedure is a closed test

nodes.summary: If the closed procedure rejects a hypothesis in `H0`, then the local test of the intersection hypothesis `H_{H0}` rejects.
nodes.title: Closed testing rejection implies the intersection test rejects

nodes.summary: The Bonferroni local test of `H_{H0}` has level `α ∈ [0, 1]` when the p-values in `H0` are valid.
nodes.title: Level of the Bonferroni local test

nodes.summary: If `H0` is the set of true nulls and the local test of `H_{H0}` rejects with probability at most `α`, then the closed procedure rejects some true null with probability at most `α`. Applied to every possible `H0`, local level-`α` tests give strong control of the family-wise error rate. No assumption on the dependence between local tests is made.
nodes.title: The closed testing principle

nodes.summary: Membership in the closed rejection set.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
